name: @zuke/git
description: Typed git task wrappers for Zuke builds — common commands (add, commit, push, tag, checkout, …) and the interrogation surface (merge-base, rev-list, for-each-ref, ls-tree, cat-file, blame, shortlog, grep) with readers for the answers a build asks for, plus a generic escape hatch, via an injection-free settings-lambda API.
